title: Conforming Virtual Element Method for Biharmonic Poisson-Nernst-Planck Navier-Stokes systems
summary: We develop and analyze a conforming Virtual Element Method (VEM) for the fourth-order Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Navier-Stokes (PNP-NS) system. The proposed scheme is based on compatible discretizations of each component: an \(H^2\)-conforming VEM for a fourth-order electrostatic potential equation, an \(H^1\)-conforming VEM for the Nernst--Planck equations, and a \textit{divergence-free} and \textit{pressure-robust} VEM for the Navier--Stokes equations.
